name: Brea Mall
summary: Brea Mall is a well-established regional shopping center in Orange County managed by Simon Property Group, featuring a diverse mix of popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment. With over 10,000 positive reviews and a 4.5-star rating, it serves as a premier shopping destination for families and fashion-conscious shoppers throughout North Orange County.
demographics: Brea Mall attracts a diverse demographic mix reflective of Orange County's affluent suburban communities, with primary visitors ranging from middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area draws heavily from surrounding cities including Brea, Fullerton, Placentia, and Yorba Linda, with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center sees strong weekend family traffic and weekday visits from nearby office workers, with shoppers showing preferences for both value-oriented national retailers and contemporary fashion brands. The mall's positioning appeals particularly to fashion-conscious millennials and Gen X families seeking a convenient, full-service shopping experience with diverse dining options.
description: Brea Mall stands as one of Orange County's premier shopping destinations, offering a comprehensive retail experience in the heart of Brea, California. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's leading retail real estate companies, this regional mall has served the community for decades as a cornerstone of retail activity in North Orange County. The center features an extensive collection of popular retailers catering to fashion-forward shoppers, including trendy apparel, footwear, and accessories for teens and young women, alongside a diverse mix of national chains and specialty stores. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Brea Mall provides convenient access for shoppers throughout the week, complemented by ample parking and modern amenities. The mall's strong reputation is reflected in its impressive 4.5-star rating from over 10,000 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its position as a beloved shopping hub for residents across Orange County and the Inland Empire.
